briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind race toward agentic AGI as China unveils national supercluster

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. US export controls on advanced chips remain the primary geopolitical lever. Funding momentum continues unabated into Q2 2026.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with native tool orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus hits 92% on SWE-Bench; xAI Colossus v2 and DeepSeek-R2 expand context windows beyond 2M tokens. Meta's Llama 4 open weights trigger immediate forks across academic clusters.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive CAN bus, IoT and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra racks to Microsoft and CoreWeave; Saudi Arabia breaks ground on 200k H100-equivalent campus; TSMC Arizona fab yields improve for 2nm AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first publicly disclosed 10-trillion-parameter model trigger mandatory international safety audits before 2027?
